features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 16 Ricoh Gen 6 Dual-Channel Printheads
items.desc: Double the printhead configuration of the FabPro 1i. 16 industrial Ricoh Gen 6 heads in dual-channel arrangement deliver higher throughput without compromising colour consistency or sharpness across the full 1850mm print width.

items.title: Advanced Wrinkle Controller System
items.desc: Built-in precision sensors continuously monitor fabric surface tension and correct irregularities in real time, ensuring smooth, wrinkle-free media conveying throughout every production run.

items.title: Head Crash Protective System
items.desc: Real-time obstruction sensing detects fabric obstacles during carriage movement and instantly protects printheads from contact damage, safeguarding your most valuable components during high-speed operation.

items.title: 5-Stage Belt Squeeze System
items.desc: Water-resistant, 5-stage squeeze mechanism prevents lint and dust from accumulating in the belt system. Engineered specifically for high-lint textile production environments to reduce cleaning frequency and maximise uptime.

items.title: Linear Motor Precision System
items.desc: High-accuracy linear motor drives carriage movement with smooth acceleration and sub-millimetre positioning control, maintaining consistent registration across the full print width even during double-speed production runs.

items.title: Automatic Capping and Wiping System
items.desc: Automated printhead capping and wiping between runs prevents ink from drying on nozzles, maintains consistent ink flow, and extends printhead operational life across long production shifts.

items.title: Customizable Drying System
items.desc: Integrated belt and fins heater with adjustable temperature zones accommodates the full range of fabric types, from lightweight silk and chiffon to heavy upholstery and curtain fabrics, ensuring optimal drying at every weight.

items.title: Efficient Ink Supply System
items.desc: High-capacity ink delivery system maintains a consistent, uninterrupted ink flow to all 16 printheads simultaneously, preventing pressure drops or ink starvation during sustained high-speed production.

items.title: Higher Mechanical Precision
items.desc: Tighter mechanical tolerances improve overall print accuracy and registration for sharper, repeatable output.

items.title: Integrated Feeding System
items.desc: Built-in feeding system supports roll diameters of up to 400 mm for smooth, continuous media handling.

items.title: Precise X-Motion Guideway System
items.desc: Maintains accurate carriage positioning across the full print width for consistent registration.

sections.heading: Fabric Preparation and Post-Printing Process
intro: Direct to fabric printing needs preparation before printing and finishing after it. The exact steps depend on the fabric and the ink.
Before printing: fabric is pretreated so the ink fixes properly and prints sharply. FabPro 2i handles fabrics from 30 to 450 gsm.

sections.heading: Real-World Production Capacity of a Direct to Fabric Printing Machine
sections.intro: FabPro 2i has two speed figures: up to 150 lm/hr standard and up to 250 lm/hr maximum.
sections.note: Maximum speed is best for bi-directional printing on lighter designs where speed matters most. Standard speed is the everyday production setting, balancing speed with print quality. Single-direction printing, dense fabrics and dark, full-coverage designs all slow output further. Real daily output also depends on roll changes, design changes and maintenance time.

sections.heading: Production Setup and Auxiliary Equipment
paragraphs: FabPro 2i takes fabric rolls up to 400 mm in diameter and 200 kg, runs on neoStampa RIP software and holds 15 litres of ink.

paragraphs.title: Before installation, plan for:
list: Floor space for the machine, fabric feeding and collection, and roll storage
Stable power with voltage stabilisation and backup
Finishing equipment: a steamer and washer for reactive and acid inks, or heat fixation for disperse
Operator training, which Orange O Tec provides at installation
paragraphs.footnote: Our team shares exact dimensions and power requirements during site planning.

sections.heading: Print Quality on Long Production Runs
paragraphs: On long runs, quality problems usually come from three sources: colour drift, nozzle dropouts and fabric problems. FabPro 2i is designed to address all three. Its uninterrupted ink supply keeps ink flow steady, so colour stays consistent across the full fabric width from the first metre to the last. Automatic capping and wiping keep nozzles clean between jobs. Sensor-based head crash protection stops fabric obstructions from damaging heads mid-run.
On the floor, operators should check nozzles at the start of every shift and compare printed colour against an approved sample at regular intervals.

paragraphs.intro: FabPro 2i protects its Ricoh Gen 6 printheads in three ways:
list: Sensor-based head crash protection detects raised fabric or obstructions before they hit the heads
Automatic capping seals the heads when idle so ink doesn’t dry in the nozzles
Automatic wiping cleans the nozzle plates to keep printing sharp
paragraphs.footnote: For routine maintenance, run a nozzle check every shift, clean the heads when nozzles drop out, keep the print blanket clean and keep the ink tank topped up.

items.q: What is a direct to fabric printing machine?
items.a: A direct to fabric printing machine prints designs straight onto fabric from a digital file, without transfer paper or screens. FabPro 2i prints on cotton, linen, silk, nylon, polyester and blends.
FabPro 2i prints up to 150 lm/hr at standard speed and up to 250 lm/hr at maximum speed.

items.q: What is the difference between FabPro 1i and FabPro 2i?
items.a: FabPro 2i is built for higher volumes. It prints up to 250 lm/hr, compared with up to 110 lm/hr on FabPro 1i.
It uses reactive, acid and disperse inks with an 8-colour setup: C, M, Y, K, Orange, Red, Blue and Green.
Yes. FabPro 2i is made in India.

items.q: What equipment do I need besides the printer?
items.a: You’ll need pretreatment equipment, plus a steamer and washer for reactive and acid inks, or heat fixation for disperse ink.

items.q: Does Orange O Tec provide installation and support?
items.a: Yes. Our team handles installation and operator training, and Orange O Tec’s 85+ service engineers provide after-sales support across India.
